title: TestGRAD: Evolving Test Suites via Failure Pattern Momentum for SWE-Agent Ensemble
title_zh: TestGRAD: Evolving Test Suites via Failure Pattern Momentum for SWE-Agent Ensemble

paragraphs.en: SWE-agent ensembles improve issue resolution by combining candidate patches from different agents with complementary strengths. The central problem is therefore test-based selection: generate tests, execute candidate patches, and identify the best patch. We formulate this process as test-space optimization : evolving an executable repository test suite until it distinguishes competing patches. Existing test-generation methods are limited optimizers. They usually lack an explicit loss for ensemble selection, optimize through incomplete directions that mostly create new tests or delete old ones, and perform one-off generation without feedback from repeated failures.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-智能体集成通过结合不同智能体提供的、具有互补优势的候选补丁，从而改进问题修复。 因此，核心问题在于基于测试的选择：生成测试用例，执行候选补丁，并识别出最佳补丁。 我们将这一过程表述为测试空间优化：持续演化可执行的仓库测试套件，直到其能够区分相互竞争的补丁。 现有的测试生成方法只是有限的优化器。 它们通常缺乏用于集成选择的明确损失函数，通过不完整的方向进行优化（主要生成新测试用例或删除旧测试用例），并且是一次性生成，无法从重复失败中获得反馈。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by gradient descent with momentum, we introduce TestGRAD , a framework for automatic test optimization. TestGRAD centers on three concepts. Differential loss gives the optimizer an explicit execution-defined target: useful tests should separate candidate patches by behavior. Full CRUD gradients expand the update direction from merely creating or deleting tests to reading existing test infrastructure, creating new tests, updating stale assertions, and deleting only obsolete tests. Failure Pattern Momentum mines frequent failure sequences from memory, allowing the optimizer to avoid repeated non-discriminative directions while compressing the failure-history context. On SWE-bench Verified, TestGRAD achieves 84.2% Pass@1 with a 4-agent ensemble, outperforming the strongest baseline (80.6%) by an absolute improvement of 3.6 percentage points , while compressing failure-history context by over 100 × 100{\times} .
paragraphs.zh: 受带动量的梯度下降启发，我们提出了 TestGRAD——一个用于自动测试优化的框架。 TestGRAD 围绕三个核心概念展开。 微分损失为优化器提供了一个明确的、由执行定义的目标：有用的测试应能通过行为差异区分候选代码块。 完整的 CRUD 梯度将更新方向从单纯的创建或删除测试，扩展到读取现有测试基础设施、创建新测试、更新过时的断言，以及仅删除冗余的测试。 失败模式动量会从记忆中挖掘高频的失败序列，使优化器能够避免重复采取无区分性的方向，同时压缩失败历史上下文。 在 SWE-bench Verified 数据集上，TestGRAD 通过一个由 4 个智能体组成的集成模型实现了 84.2% 的 Pass@1 通过率，比最强的基线模型（80.6%）绝对提升了 3.6 个百分点，同时将失败历史上下文压缩了超过 100 × 100{\times}。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering (SWE) agents autonomously resolve repository issues by localizing faults, generating patches, and validating fixes in a live coding environment ( Jimenez et al. 2023 ; Lingxi Authors 2025 ) . Different agents exhibit complementary strengths: an agent that fails on one issue may still produce the best patch for another. A practical way to exploit this diversity is parallel ensembling, where multiple SWE agents generate candidate patches and a selector chooses the final patch ( Se and Vert 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程（SWE）智能体能够在实时编码环境中，通过定位故障、生成补丁并验证修复方案，自主解决仓库问题（Jimenez 等人，2023；Lingxi Authors，2025）。 不同的智能体展现出互补的优势：一个在某个问题上表现不佳的智能体，可能仍能为另一个问题生成最佳补丁。 利用这种多样性的实用方法是并行集成，即多个 SWE 智能体共同生成候选补丁，再由一个选择器挑选最终补丁（Se 和 Vert，2025）。

sents.en: A practical way to exploit this diversity is parallel ensembling, where multiple SWE agents generate candidate patches and a selector chooses the final patch ( Se and Vert 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 利用这种多样性的实用方法是并行集成，即多个 SWE 智能体共同生成候选补丁，再由一个选择器挑选最终补丁（Se 和 Vert，2025）。

paragraphs.en: The selector must be grounded in behavior. A natural but weak approach is to ask an LLM judge to compare candidate patches and select the most plausible fix ( Augment Code 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ) . Without execution evidence, however, the judge sees surface plausibility rather than repository behavior and can be sensitive to presentation order ( Wang et al. 2023 ; Zheng et al. 2024 ) . The key to SWE-agent ensembling is therefore test-based selection : generate tests, execute every candidate patch, and use the resulting behavior to identify the correct patch.
paragraphs.zh: 选择器必须基于行为进行定位。 一种自然但较弱的方法是让大型语言模型（LLM）裁判比较候选补丁，并选出最合理的修复方案（Augment Code 2025；Zhang 等人，2025）。 然而，如果没有执行证据，裁判看到的只是表面上的合理性，而非代码库中的实际行为，并且可能受到呈现顺序的影响（Wang 等人，2023；Zheng 等人，2024）。 因此，SWE-智能体集成方法的关键在于基于测试的选择：生成测试用例，执行每个候选补丁，并利用由此产生的行为来识别正确的补丁。

paragraphs.en: This view turns ensemble selection into test-space optimization : the optimized object is the repository test suite, and the objective is to evolve it for better selection. This is difficult for three reasons. First, the loss is not obvious. A test that simply passes or fails is not necessarily useful for selection; even patches that pass benchmark tests can remain behaviorally divergent from developer fixes ( Wang, Pradel, and Liu 2026 ) . Second, the update direction cannot be limited to creating new tests. Useful repository tests often require reading fixtures and conventions, updating stale assertions, and deleting only confirmed obsolete tests ( Mündler et al. 2025 ) . Third, test generation is rarely solved in one step: when an attempted test is non-discriminative, the next attempt should use that failure as optimization signal rather than restart from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 这种观点将集成选择转化为测试空间优化：被优化的对象是代码库的测试套件，而目标则是通过演化该套件来实现更好的选择。 这存在三个方面的困难。 首先，损失函数并不明显。 一个仅通过或失败的测试未必对选择有用；即便是通过基准测试的补丁，其行为也可能与开发人员的修复方案存在差异（Wang, Pradel, and Liu 2026）。 其次，更新方向不能局限于创建新的测试。 有用的代码库测试通常需要读取固定设施和惯例、更新过时的断言，并仅删除已确认过时的测试（Mündler et al. 2025）。 第三，测试生成很少能一步完成：当尝试生成的测试缺乏区分性时，下一次尝试应将该失败作为优化信号，而非从头开始。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by gradient descent with momentum in neural networks ( Polyak 1964 ; Sutskever et al. 2013 ) , we introduce TestGRAD , a framework that models test-suite evolution as gradient-descent-like optimization in test space. Table 1 summarizes the analogy. A test suite is the parameter state, differential execution is the loss, CRUD edits are gradient directions, frequent failure sequences are momentum, support is the retention weight, and the LLM agent is the optimizer. In the forward pass, TestGRAD executes the current test suite on candidate patches and observes whether their behaviors differ. In the backward pass, the LLM optimizer uses this execution-defined signal and mined failure momentum to produce the next CRUD test update. The design has three components.
paragraphs.zh: 受神经网络中带动量的梯度下降方法（Polyak 1964；Sutskever 等，2013）的启发，我们提出了 TestGRAD——一个将测试套件演化建模为测试空间中类梯度下降优化的框架。 表 1 总结了这种类比关系。 测试套件是参数状态，差异执行是损失函数，CRUD 操作是梯度方向，频繁出现的失败序列是动量，支持是保留权重，而 LLM 智能体则是优化器。 在前向传播阶段，TestGRAD 会在候选补丁上执行当前测试套件，并观察其行为是否存在差异。 在后向传播阶段，LLM 优化器会利用这种由执行过程定义的信号以及挖掘出的失败动量，生成下一个 CRUD 测试更新。 该设计包含三个组成部分。

paragraphs.en: ➀ Differential loss. TestGRAD makes the optimization target explicit: a useful test suite should separate candidate patches by behavior. We define the loss by execution. If the current test suite contains a differential test, meaning at least one test passes on some candidate patches and fails on others, the loss reaches zero. Otherwise, the loss remains nonzero and the failed update is used to guide the next iteration. This differs from pass-count selection ( Xia et al. 2025 ; Gao et al. 2025 ) , which simply chooses the patch that passes the most tests. Differential loss instead searches for behavioral contrast among candidates rather than merely verifying the intended fix. It prunes candidates that are indistinguishable under the current tests and discourages selection based on a single weak pass/fail signal.
paragraphs.zh: ➀ 差异损失。 TestGRAD 使优化目标变得明确：一个有效的测试套件应能根据行为区分候选补丁。 我们通过执行来定义损失函数。 如果当前测试套件包含差异测试，即至少有一个测试在某些候选补丁上通过而在其他补丁上失败，则损失为零。 否则，损失保持非零，失败的更新将用于指导下一次迭代。 这与通过次数选择方法（Xia et al. 2025；Gao et al. 2025）不同，后者仅选择通过测试最多的补丁。 差异损失则是在候选补丁中寻找行为差异，而不仅仅是验证预期的修复效果。 它会剪除在当前测试下无法区分的候选补丁，并避免基于单一的弱通过/失败信号进行选择。

paragraphs.en: TestGRAD therefore exposes all four directions as the test-space gradient. R ead extracts repository-specific testing knowledge for reuse. C reate adds new discriminative tests. U pdate revises stale assertions or test bodies whose expected behavior changes with the fix. D elete removes only tests confirmed obsolete. This full direction avoids shallow standalone tests, preserves high-signal tests that only need assertion updates, and prevents a correct patch from being rejected simply because an old assertion was left unchanged.

paragraphs.en: ➂ Failure Pattern Momentum. In numerical optimization, momentum accumulates consistent gradient information across steps and helps avoid oscillation or repeated dead ends. TestGRAD uses an analogous mechanism for test updates. When a CRUD update produces a non-discriminative suite, the failed update is written into failure memory. TestGRAD then mines maximal frequent failure sequences from this memory. These sequences form Failure Pattern Momentum: compact evidence of directions that have repeatedly failed. The next LLM optimizer step receives this momentum and can move away from recurring non-discriminative regions of the test-suite space. Compared with summarizing failures using another LLM call ( Shinn et al. 2023 ) or feeding raw test-execution feedback back to the generator ( Huang et al. 2023 ) , this design is deterministic, faithful to observed failures, and compresses context by over 100 × 100{\times} .

paragraphs.en: On SWE-bench Verified (500 instances) ( SWE-bench 2025 ) , TestGRAD achieves 84.2% Pass@1 with a 4-agent ensemble using Minimax-m2.7, outperforming the next-best baseline (TRAE, 80.6%) by an absolute improvement of 3.6 percentage points and the single-agent baseline by 5.0 percentage points . paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents have transformed automated program repair, with recent systems resolving over half of real-world GitHub issues on SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al. 2023 ) . Representative frameworks include Agentless ( Xia et al. 2025 ) , which decomposes repair into localization, patch generation, and validation, OpenHands ( Wang et al. 2024 ) , which enables interactive repository navigation with tool use, and Lingxi ( Lingxi Authors 2025 ) , which guides issue resolution using procedural knowledge from past fixes. Because different SWE agents exhibit complementary strengths ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) , ensembling their candidate patches is a natural way to improve Pass@1. The key question is how to generate tests that can distinguish the correct patch from plausible but wrong alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体彻底改变了自动化程序修复领域，近期系统已能解决 SWE-bench 平台上超过一半的真实 GitHub 问题（Jimenez 等人，2023）。 代表性框架包括 Agentless（Xia 等人，2025），它将修复过程分解为问题定位、补丁生成和验证；OpenHands（Wang 等人，2024），它支持通过工具使用实现交互式仓库导航；以及 Lingxi（Lingxi 作者团队，2025），它利用过往修复中的程序性知识来指导问题解决。 由于不同的 SWE 智能体展现出互补的优势（Zhang 等人，2025），因此将它们生成的候选补丁进行集成，是提升 Pass@1 指标的自然方法。 关键问题在于如何生成能够区分正确补丁与看似合理但错误的替代方案的测试用例。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the analogy that motivates TestGRAD : tests are optimized as text-space parameters, CRUD edits instantiate the gradient direction, frequent failure sequences provide momentum, and the LLM agent acts as the optimizer.
paragraphs.zh: 表1总结了启发TestGRAD的类比：测试被优化为文本空间参数，CRUD编辑实例化了梯度方向，频繁出现的失败序列提供了动量，而LLM智能体则充当了优化器。

paragraphs.en: LIBRO ( Kang, Yoon, and Yoo 2023 ) generates a reproduction test directly from the issue description and ranks candidate patches by pass/fail outcome. Agentless ( Xia et al. 2025 ) follows a related Create-Delete pipeline: it creates a new test from the issue description and removes conflicting tests by name matching. These pipelines provide useful execution evidence, but they are incomplete as test optimizers in three ways. First, their update direction is mostly limited to creating tests, with deletion used only as a coarse cleanup step. They do not read and update the existing test suite, so they miss project-specific fixtures, base classes, helper assertions, and stale assertions that need in-place revision. Second, their objective is not a differential loss over candidate patches. A test may pass or fail, but the generator is not directly optimized to maximize behavioral separation among competing patches. Third, they are largely one-off: once the first generated test is non-discriminative, there is no principled iterative optimization process that turns that failure into the next test-suite update.
paragraphs.zh: LIBRO（Kang、Yoon 和 Yoo，2023）直接从问题描述中生成一个复现测试，并根据通过/失败的结果对候选补丁进行排序。 Agentless（Xia 等人，2025）遵循一个相关的“创建-删除”流程：它根据问题描述创建一个新测试，并通过名称匹配移除冲突的测试。 这些流程提供了有用的执行证据，但作为测试优化器，它们在三个方面尚不完整。 首先，它们的更新方向主要局限于创建测试，而删除仅被用作粗略的清理步骤。 它们不会读取和更新现有的测试套件，因此会遗漏项目特定的固定组件、基类、辅助断言以及需要原地修订的陈旧断言。 其次，它们的目标并非针对候选补丁的差异化损失。 一个测试可能通过或失败，但生成器并未直接优化以最大化竞争补丁之间的行为差异。 第三，它们大多是单次操作：一旦首个生成的测试无法区分差异，就没有基于原则的迭代优化过程能将这种失败转化为下一次测试套件的更新。

paragraphs.en: AEGIS ( Wang et al. 2025 ) uses FSM-guided script generation to reproduce bug symptoms as standalone scripts. These scripts verify whether the symptom disappears, but they do not integrate with the project’s native test suite and cannot fully capture behavioral regression. TRAE ( Gao et al. 2025 ) adds agentic browsing over source files to inform test creation, but it still follows a Create/Delete style of test generation, does not optimize a differential loss, and does not maintain momentum across failed test updates. TestGRAD extends this line of work by treating the test suite itself as the optimized object: it reads existing tests, updates stale assertions, creates new discriminative tests, deletes only confirmed obsolete tests, and iteratively evolves the suite using Failure Pattern Momentum.

paragraphs.en: Reflexion ( Shinn et al. 2023 ) and Self-Refine ( Madaan et al. 2023 ) introduced the paradigm of linguistic self-reflection: an agent receives execution feedback, generates a natural-language reflection, and uses it to guide subsequent attempts. Language Agent Tree Search (LATS) ( Zhou et al. 2024 ) scales this idea with Monte Carlo Tree Search, using LM-powered value functions to explore the space of possible actions. These frameworks rely on an LLM evaluator to produce the reflection signal, which is costly and may hallucinate for fine-grained code-correctness reasoning. AgentCoder ( Huang et al. 2023 ) instead uses a test executor agent that runs generated tests and feeds the raw execution results back to the programmer agent for refinement, without abstracting recurring failures across attempts.
paragraphs.zh: Reflexion（Shinn 等人，2023）和 Self-Refine（Madaan 等人，2023）提出了语言自我反思的范式：一个智能体接收执行反馈，生成自然语言形式的反思，并以此指导后续尝试。 语言智能体树搜索（LATS）（Zhou 等人，2024）通过蒙特卡洛树搜索扩展了这一思路，利用大语言模型驱动的价值函数来探索可能的动作空间。 这些框架依赖一个大语言模型评估器来生成反思信号，但这种方式成本高昂，且在对代码正确性进行精细推理时可能出现幻觉。 AgentCoder（Huang 等人，2023）则采用了一个测试执行智能体：它运行生成的测试，并将原始执行结果反馈给程序员智能体以进行改进，而不会对跨多次尝试的重复失败进行抽象处理。

sents.en: Language Agent Tree Search (LATS) ( Zhou et al. 2024 ) scales this idea with Monte Carlo Tree Search, using LM-powered value functions to explore the space of possible actions.
sents.zh: 语言智能体树搜索（LATS）（Zhou 等人，2024）通过蒙特卡洛树搜索扩展了这一思路，利用大语言模型驱动的价值函数来探索可能的动作空间。

sents.en: These frameworks rely on an LLM evaluator to produce the reflection signal, which is costly and may hallucinate for fine-grained code-correctness reasoning.
sents.zh: 这些框架依赖一个大语言模型评估器来生成反思信号，但这种方式成本高昂，且在对代码正确性进行精细推理时可能出现幻觉。

sents.en: AgentCoder ( Huang et al. 2023 ) instead uses a test executor agent that runs generated tests and feeds the raw execution results back to the programmer agent for refinement, without abstracting recurring failures across attempts.
sents.zh: AgentCoder（Huang 等人，2023）则采用了一个测试执行智能体：它运行生成的测试，并将原始执行结果反馈给程序员智能体以进行改进，而不会对跨多次尝试的重复失败进行抽象处理。

paragraphs.en: TextGrad ( Yuksekgonul et al. 2025 ) gives this idea a more explicit optimization form: LLM feedback is backpropagated through text variables in a computation graph, so prompts, predictions, code snippets, or other textual components can be improved by natural-language gradients. metaTextGrad ( Xu et al. 2025 ) further studies how to optimize the LLM optimizer itself, adapting both its prompt and structure for a target task. These works motivate our use of gradient-style language for test-suite optimization, but they are general text-optimization frameworks rather than a test-time SWE-agent ensemble method. In our setting, the forward signal is produced by executing candidate patches against tests, the loss is differential over patch outcomes, and the gradient direction is constrained to CRUD edits over the repository test suite.

paragraphs.en: TestGRAD takes a different approach to memory utilization. Rather than summarizing failed attempts with an LLM ( Shinn et al. 2023 ) or feeding raw execution feedback back verbatim ( Huang et al. 2023 ) , it applies sequential mining to failure memory. This produces compact maximal frequent subsequences that represent structurally identical strategies across superficially diverse patches. In TestGRAD , these sequences serve as Failure Pattern Momentum: they carry aggregate information about prior non-discriminative directions into the next LLM optimizer step. Unlike similarity-based retrieval (RAG), which returns documents similar to the query and therefore also similar to each other, sequential mining extracts cross-document structure and compresses memory by over 100 × 100{\times} in practice, keeping the optimizer’s context window available for productive repository reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: TestGRAD 对内存利用采取了不同的方法。 与使用 LLM（Shinn 等人，2023）总结失败尝试，或逐字将原始执行反馈回传（Huang 等人，2023）不同，它通过序列挖掘处理失败记忆。 这种方法能生成紧凑的最大频繁子序列，这些子序列代表了表面看似不同但结构相同的策略片段。 在 TestGRAD 中，这些序列充当“失败模式动量”：它们将先前非区分性方向的汇总信息带入下一个 LLM 优化器步骤。 与基于相似性的检索（RAG）不同——后者会返回与查询相似、因而彼此也相似的文档——序列挖掘能够提取跨文档的结构，并在实际应用中使内存压缩超过 100 × 100{\times}，从而为优化器的上下文窗口保留空间，用于对知识库进行有效推理。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on SWE-bench Verified ( OpenAI 2024 ) , a human-validated subset of 500 real-world GitHub issues. Candidate patches are drawn from six top-performing SWE-agent leaderboard submissions, added incrementally to form ensembles of size N = 1 , … , 6 N=1,\ldots,6 : Livesweagent (20251215) ( Live SWE-agent 2025 ) , Sonar (20251205) ( Sonar 2025 ) , OpenHands (20251127) ( Wang et al. 2024 ) , Trae_doubao (20250928) ( Gao et al. 2025 ) , Gemini-Live (20251120) ( Live SWE-agent 2025 ) , and Atlassian (20250902) ( Atlassian 2025 ) . At N = 1 N=1 (Livesweagent alone), the single-agent Pass@1 is 79.2%, which serves as the baseline for ensemble gain. This construction has two advantages: (1) leaderboard agents produce high-quality and diverse patches, making ensemble selection challenging; (2) all patches are publicly available, ensuring full reproducibility.

paragraphs.en: We compare TestGRAD against three ensemble methods. For a fair comparison, all methods receive the same candidate patches and differ only in their ensemble selection module. Augment ( Augment Code 2025 ) follows the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm: the LLM scores each candidate patch against the issue description and selects the most plausible fix without any test execution. Agentless ( Xia et al. 2025 ) generates a new test from the issue description and filters existing tests by name-matching heuristics, then ranks patches by execution outcome. It follows a Create-Delete (C/D) strategy with no repository inspection and no iterative optimization. TRAE ( Gao et al. 2025 ) is an agent-based selector that adds repository browsing to the C/D pipeline. It reads source files to inform test creation and applies name-based deletion to remove conflicting existing tests, but still lacks an Update operation and does not refine failing tests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 TestGRAD 与三种集成方法进行比较。 为确保公平比较，所有方法都接收相同的候选代码片段，仅集成选择模块不同。 Augment（Augment Code 2025）遵循“LLM 作为裁判”的范式：LLM 根据问题描述为每个候选代码片段打分，并选择最合理的修复方案，无需执行任何测试。 Agentless（Xia et al. 2025）根据问题描述生成新测试，通过名称匹配启发式方法筛选现有测试，然后依据执行结果对代码片段进行排序。 该方法采用“创建-删除”（C/D）策略，不涉及代码库检查或迭代优化。 TRAE（Gao et al. 2025）是一种基于智能体的选择器，在 C/D 流程中增加了代码库浏览环节。 它会读取源文件以指导测试生成，并通过基于名称的删除操作移除冲突的现有测试，但仍缺少“更新”操作，且不会优化失败的测试。

Both rely on a Create-Delete (C/D) pipeline: they generate new tests while filtering existing ones by test name, lacking holistic test suite understanding (Read) and in-place test updating (Update). paragraphs.en: Optimal ensemble size. Performance peaks at N = 4 N{=}4 (Minimax: 84.2%, DeepSeek: 84.0%, GLM: 83.6%) and slightly declines for N = 5 , 6 N{=}5,6 . This trend should not be interpreted as a violation of the ensemble principle. paragraphs.en: Table 4 reports the ablation results on Minimax-m2.7. We focus here on differential loss and the two CRUD-gradient components unique to TestGRAD : Read (test suite understanding) and Update (in-place test modification). Because the complete system and each ablation are evaluated on the same SWE-bench Verified instances, we use a paired hypothesis test rather than compare unpaired aggregate Pass@1 values. Specifically, we collect multiple paired overall Pass@1 results for the complete TestGRAD and each ablation variant, and apply a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( Wilcoxon 1945 ) at significance level α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . The complete TestGRAD shows a statistically significant advantage over every ablated variant, with all p p -values below 7.32 × 10 − 3 7.32\times 10^{-3} . The Pass@1 drops in Table 4 are then interpreted as effect sizes. For the non-differential-loss ablation, we replace the differential stopping criterion and checker-based final selection with a pass-count rule: after executing the generated tests on all candidate patches, the candidate that passes the largest number of tests wins. This variant tests whether ordinary test-pass maximization is sufficient, as opposed to explicitly optimizing for a test whose outcomes differ across candidates. Recent empirical evidence on SWE-bench further cautions against this assumption: patches that pass benchmark tests can still be behaviorally divergent from developer-written fixes, and differential patch testing exposes discrepancies missed by ordinary validation tests ( Wang, Pradel, and Liu 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Token efficiency. Figure 5 illustrates the token cost of the two strategies across optimization iterations. Raw Memory accumulates all previously failed test suites verbatim; its token count grows steadily, reaching about 1.9K–13.6K tokens by iteration 5. Momentum extracts maximal frequent subsequences from the same corpus, producing a concise momentum context that grows far more slowly, remaining on the order of tens to about a hundred tokens across iterations. The compression ratio exceeds 100 × 100{\times} for DeepSeek at later iterations and stays between 25 × 25{\times} and 40 × 40{\times} for GLM and Minimax, meaning the model receives equivalent or richer structural guidance at a fraction of the context cost. This is particularly important because excessive context length degrades LLM reasoning quality ( Liu et al. 2023 ) and inflates API costs.

paragraphs.en: We presented TestGRAD , a momentum-gradient optimizer for iterative test-space optimization. Following the analogy in Table 1 , TestGRAD treats the current test suite as the optimization state, differential execution as the loss, a one-step CRUD test update as the instantaneous gradient, and Failure Pattern Momentum as the retained direction. The LLM optimizer uses this feedback to evolve discriminative test suites, while the checker is invoked only after zero-loss differential execution for final patch selection.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 contrasts two test generation strategies on django__django-12325 , a bug where OneToOneField to a parent model should implicitly set parent_link=True instead of raising ImproperlyConfigured . The fix changes an exception-raising behavior into a silently-accepted one, making test design non-trivial: a test must assert the new correct behavior, not merely reproduce the old crash. We use this instance to identify two critical gaps in existing C/D-only (Create + Delete) approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 对比了两种测试生成策略在 django__django-12325 上的表现，这是一个错误：指向父模型的一对一字段（OneToOneField）本应隐式设置 parent_link=True，而不是抛出 ImproperlyConfigured 异常。 该修复将原本会引发异常的行为改为静默接受，这使得测试设计变得复杂：测试必须断言新的正确行为，而不仅仅是重现旧的崩溃。 我们使用这个实例来识别现有仅基于 C/D（创建 + 删除）方法中的两个关键缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Generating a test without first inspecting the repository forces the agent to reconstruct from scratch everything the project already provides. As shown in Figure 1 (A), the C/D-only reproduction script must manually configure DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE , call django.setup() , and declare app_label in every model’s Meta class, boilerplate that Django’s own test suite has long abstracted away behind the @isolate_apps decorator. Beyond verbosity, this hand-rolled setup is fragile: without the app registry being properly initialized, ParkingLot.check() may raise an unrelated AppRegistryNotReady error rather than the assertion under test. Even when it does run, the reproduction script asserts that ImproperlyConfigured is raised, the old behavior, so it passes on both the correct and incorrect patches and is therefore invalid.
paragraphs.zh: 如果不先检查代码库就生成测试，智能体将被迫从头重建项目已经提供的一切内容。 如图 1（A）所示，仅包含 C/D 的复现脚本必须手动配置 DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE、调用 django.setup()，并在每个模型的 Meta 类中声明 app_label——这些样板代码早已被 Django 自身的测试套件通过 @isolate_apps 装饰器抽象掉了。 除了冗长之外，这种手工搭建的设置还十分脆弱：如果应用注册表未得到正确初始化，ParkingLot.check() 可能会引发一个与测试断言无关的 AppRegistryNotReady 错误。 即使脚本能够运行，其复现过程也会断言会触发 ImproperlyConfigured 异常（旧版行为），因此无论补丁正确与否都会通过测试，从而使其结果无效。

Because it is executed by Django’s standard test runner inside the existing test environment, infrastructure errors are eliminated and the assertion directly targets the new correct behavior.

paragraphs.en: A correct patch does not always add behavior. It often changes expected values that existing tests already assert. In django__django-12325 , the fix causes OneToOneField to acquire an implicit parent_link=True attribute, which alters the serialized migration state that test_render inspects. The original test_render does not include parent_link=True in its expected field kwargs, so after the correct patch is applied, test_render fails, not because the patch is wrong, but because the test asserts the old (now-incorrect) behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 正确的补丁并不总是会添加新功能。 它通常会改变现有测试已经断言的预期值。 在 django__django-12325 中，该修复导致 OneToOneField 获得一个隐式的 parent_link=True 属性，从而改变了 test_render 所检查的序列化迁移状态。 原始的 test_render 并未在其预期的字段 kwargs 中包含 parent_link=True，因此应用正确的补丁后，test_render 会失败——并非因为补丁有误，而是因为测试断言了旧版（现已不正确）的行为。

paragraphs.en: A C/D-only pipeline resolves this conflict in one of two ways, both harmful. If it deletes test_render by name-based heuristics, it discards a structurally sound test that could have been a strong discriminator after a one-line edit. If it leaves test_render unchanged, the test penalizes the correct patch: it passes on every incorrect patch (which does not change field serialization) and fails on the correct one, inverting the desired discrimination signal.
paragraphs.zh: 仅支持 C/D 的管道通过两种有害方式之一来解决这一冲突。 如果它基于名称启发式策略删除 test_render，就会丢弃一个结构上合理的测试用例，而该测试本可以在一行编辑后成为强有力的区分指标。 如果它保留 test_render 不变，这个测试就会惩罚正确的补丁：它在所有错误的补丁（不改变字段序列化的补丁）上都通过，而在正确的补丁上却失败，从而颠倒了预期的区分信号。

paragraphs.en: These two gaps, infrastructure-unaware test generation and destructive handling of behavior-changing patches, motivate using CRUD as the gradient direction over the test suite rather than a conventional C/D pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个问题——基础设施无关的测试生成以及对行为变更补丁的破坏性处理——促使我们采用 CRUD 作为测试套件上的梯度方向，而非传统的 C/D 流程。

paragraphs.en: Momentum in iterative test optimization relies on conditioning on past history. However, how these failures are represented introduces critical limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代测试优化中的动量依赖于对过往历史的条件约束。 然而，这些失败如何被表示会引入关键的限制。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches typically adopt one of two strategies. As discussed in the main paper, one line of work summarizes failures using an additional LLM, while another directly appends raw failed history to the model input.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通常采用两种策略之一。 如主论文中所讨论的，一种研究路线使用额外的 LLM 来总结失败情况，而另一种则直接将原始失败历史附加到模型输入中。

sents.en: Existing approaches typically adopt one of two strategies.
sents.zh: 现有方法通常采用两种策略之一。

sents.en: As discussed in the main paper, one line of work summarizes failures using an additional LLM, while another directly appends raw failed history to the model input.

paragraphs.en: Both strategies are problematic. LLM-based summarization incurs additional inference cost at every iteration, and its outputs may omit or distort key structural details due to abstraction or hallucination. In contrast, directly injecting raw failure history preserves full information but leads to rapidly growing context size and severe redundancy, as many failed test suites correspond to the same underlying strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种策略都存在一定问题。 基于大型语言模型的摘要生成在每次迭代中都会产生额外的推理成本，并且其输出可能因抽象或幻觉而遗漏或歪曲关键的结构细节。 相比之下，直接注入原始失败历史虽然能保留全部信息，但会导致上下文规模迅速增长并出现严重冗余，因为许多失败的测试套件都对应着相同的底层策略。

paragraphs.en: This redundancy is not merely a matter of efficiency. As illustrated in Figure 3(b) of the main paper, independently generated failed test suites often share the same core logic despite superficial differences. When presented in raw form, such failures create an illusion of diversity, causing the optimizer to repeatedly explore equivalent strategies under different surface realizations.
paragraphs.zh: 这种冗余不仅仅是效率问题。 正如主论文中的图 3(b) 所示，独立生成的失败测试套件尽管表面存在差异，但通常共享相同的核心逻辑。 当以原始形式呈现时，这类失败会营造出一种多样性的假象，导致优化器在不同表面实现下反复探索等效的策略。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, as failure memory grows, redundant patches occupy an increasing fraction of the context window, crowding out essential information such as the issue description and repository context, and leaving less capacity for effective reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，随着故障记忆的积累，冗余补丁在上下文窗口中占据的比例越来越大，挤出了问题描述和仓库上下文等关键信息，导致可用于有效推理的空间减少。

paragraphs.en: Overall, existing failure representation strategies either sacrifice fidelity (LLM summarization) or scalability (raw history), and neither provides a compact, faithful abstraction of recurring failure modes. TestGRAD therefore treats maximal frequent failure sequences as momentum: a compact, deterministic signal that carries prior failed directions into the next CRUD update.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有的故障表示策略要么牺牲保真度（LLM 摘要），要么牺牲可扩展性（原始历史记录），且两者都无法提供对重复出现的故障模式的紧凑而忠实的抽象。 因此，TestGRAD 将最大频率的故障序列视为动量：一种紧凑且确定性的信号，它将先前失败的方向带入下一次 CRUD 更新中。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports average per-instance time and token consumption across all four methods and three base LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 报告了所有四种方法和三种基础 LLM 的平均单实例时间和令牌消耗量。

paragraphs.en: TestGRAD ’s token cost is higher than all baselines for two structural reasons. First, the Read step issues repository exploration calls once per generation round to extract test-suite understanding. Second, TestGRAD may run up to T max = 8 T_{\max}=8 momentum-guided optimization steps per instance, which raises the average token cost to 670K–1,670K per instance. By contrast, Augment and Agentless are one-shot LLM calls, and TRAE runs a single agentic pass without iterative feedback, so their token budgets are structurally lower. This overhead is the direct cost of two design choices: holistic test-suite understanding and iterative momentum optimization, which account for most of the accuracy gain.
paragraphs.zh: TestGRAD 的令牌成本高于所有基线模型，这有两个结构性原因。 首先，Read 步骤在每次生成轮次中都会发出一次仓库探索调用，以提取测试套件的理解信息。 其次，TestGRAD 在每个实例上最多可能运行 T_{\max}=8 个由动量引导的优化步骤，这将平均令牌成本提高到每个实例 670K–1,670K。 相比之下，Augment 和 Agentless 是单次 LLM 调用，而 TRAE 则执行一次智能体流程且没有迭代反馈，因此它们的令牌预算在结构上更低。 这种额外开销是两种设计选择的直接成本：全面的测试套件理解和迭代的动量优化，这两者贡献了大部分准确率提升。
